# Bounded Upheaval compiler sample

`provenance.json` identifies four complete historical source files from
`068643219fded09a05fb7b75c6507b769c430316`, including Git blob and SHA256.
Their business fields, byte order, BOM and line endings are unchanged.

`Data/Mod.xml`, `Defines.xml` and `Derived.xml` are synthetic adapters. They add
includes, repeated expressions and two cross-document inherited Armor assets.
The group has seven assets and no Art, Texture, Audio or external asset closure.

`CompilerUpheavalSamples` exercises fresh cold, memory-session warm and persisted
session output for the default and fallback document snapshot paths. GitHub
Actions compares the same input against an independent original BAB process.
This sample does not replace complete mymod or full Upheaval acceptance.
